name: New Guinea Coastal Undercurrent
scope: Declared north-Papua New Guinea regional reach from an OSW offshore Vitiaz-downstream approach gate near 147 E, 4.5 S to the 142 E, 2.5 S mooring neighborhood. Excludes passage through Vitiaz Strait itself, upstream Solomon Sea coastal branches, New Britain and St Georges branches, and the cross-equatorial EUC connection. Gates do not establish whole-current origin or termination.
layer: Subsurface thermocline flow. Ueki et al. report a local northwestward core generally at 150–250 m near the moorings; the core shoals during El Nino. This local depth support is not a fixed-depth axis assigned along the entire editorial reach. Surface New Guinea Coastal Current remains a separate identity.
time_convention: Editorial regional geographic reach informed by Ueki et al. mooring observations during 1995–2000 and Grenier et al. background/model pathways. The source reports seasonal and ENSO variations locally; this static route is not a dated observation, annual axis or observed seasonal length/width footprint. Source seasons use boreal labels: winter January–March, summer July–September, fall October–December. Unlisted months are not inferred flow absence.
source_locator: Ueki et al. (2003), Introduction [2]–[7]: separate surface and thermocline flows, northern PNG coast and gateway relations; Data [8]: 142 E moorings; Results 3.1 [17]–[18]: local 150–250 m core and El Nino shoaling. Relevant text inspected; no current axis digitized.
source_citation: Ueki, Kashino and Kuroda (2003), Observation of current variations off the New Guinea coast including the 1997–1998 El Nino period and their relationship with Sverdrup transport, Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans, doi:10.1029/2002JC001611.
source_license: Publisher full text accessible; no explicit open reuse license inspected. Attributed regional facts paraphrased; source current profiles, figures and ADCP fields are not copied.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects coarse offshore vertices along northern Papua New Guinea between a declared downstream approach to the Vitiaz outflow and the source mooring neighborhood at 142 E, 2.5 S. Mooring coordinate is a local observational location, not current termination. Intermediate vertices are not source-provided measurements or a digitized bathymetric axis. Strait passages and branch junctions are not traced.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW coarse lateral alternative; not an observed seasonal path, current edge or width.

scenario_rule: Three declared regional shapes crossed with uniform longitude shifts -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees and independent endpoint latitude shifts -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 81 editorial scenarios. Not current width, seasonal extent or a confidence interval.
remaining_gates: Review finer coastline and bathymetry before claiming a subsurface coastal axis.
